market_assessment.text: TAIEX fell -1.30% (-589.33 pts) to 44,719.35, gapping down at open (45,071 = prev close -237) and selling to low of 44,308 before recovering slightly. Open=High pattern = opened at the high and went straight down - no intraday recovery. Three institutions net sold a MASSIVE -708.48B NTD (3x yesterday's -239.30B): foreign -416.39B (3.5x yesterday), trust FLIPPED from +56.63B buy to -120.91B sell (no institutional support), proprietary -171.18B (hedge -131.56B). Volume shrank to 8,857B (from 10,079B) - low volume + heavy selling = lack of dip-buying. Plastics -5.27% crashed (worse than semis -1.40%), energy -2.21% (hedge failed). Defensive sectors gained: Sports Leisure +1.47%, Trade Retail +1.31%, Food +0.98%, Shipping +0.86%. Recommendation results: 2882 MISS (no entry opportunity, rec price 97.5 vs close 98.3), 6505 MISS (-2.50%, energy hedge failed), 2330 HIT (observe-only correct - 2330 fell only -1.26% vs ADR implied -4%). SOX -4.98% system crash transmitted to TW market but impact was moderate (-1.30%) thanks to 2330 resilience.

reviews.name: Cathay Financial Holding
reviews.analysis: Rec price 97.5 never touched - opened at 99.2, closed 98.3 above entry price. Financials relatively resilient (-0.91% vs TAIEX -1.30%) but no breakout above 100. Defensive rotation logic correct but entry price too low vs actual gap-down open.

reviews.name: Formosa Petrochemical
reviews.analysis: Entry at 71 was touched (low 70.1) but direction wrong. Energy failed as hedge - 6505 fell -2.50% alongside market. Oil flat at $84.44 but 6505 decoupled. Yesterday's high-to-close pullback (76.2->72.0) preceded today's continued decline - confirms momentum reversal pattern.

reviews.name: TSMC
reviews.analysis: Observe-only call was correct. 2330 fell only -1.26% (vs ADR -4.07% implied gap-down to 2290-2310). 2300 support never tested - opened at 2340. TW market more resilient than ADR suggested. ADR premium compressed from +15.53% to +12.17%. Not chasing the bounce was the right call.
